basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old avid gamer and anime enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. My passion lies in online trading games like Royale High, where I'm always on the lookout for the next best deal. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy watching sports anime, especially Kuroko's Basketball, and often engage in discussions about my favorite episodes. My daily routine includes some time spent on Reddit in the evenings after work, where I manage a small retail store. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom it brings to dive deep into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have extensive knowledge in virtual item trading, primarily self-taught through years of experience in various online games. My understanding of market trends and valuation stems from actively participating in trading communities. Additionally, my interest in anime is backed by years of watching and discussing series with fellow fans.
